title: Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, probes continue
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: Nvidia said on Mon 23 Nov that its board unanimously reinstated Huang as CEO with immediate effect after input from senior US government officials, with Kress returning to CFO; NPR reports the shares jumped, and MS NOW reports Trump said he had spoken with board members about the decision. The board says its independent probe into the reported foreign intelligence effort will continue, the reported SEC inquiry is still open, and Huang faces closed-door House interviews on 1 Dec and a Senate Banking hearing on export controls on 3 Dec, Investing.com reports.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: House committees' closed-door interview with Huang, Senate hearing 3 Dec
sources: Nvidia, NPR, Fox Business, Al Jazeera, PBS, MS NOW, Investing.com, CoinDesk

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: UKMTO reported a tanker incident involving military forces near the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman on Sun 22 Nov; Gulf News cites an analyst who says the US struck a tanker carrying Iranian oil, but neither side has confirmed this and AFP says CENTCOM had not commented as of Monday. Iran's foreign ministry said on Mon 23 Nov it will use every means to counter the blockade after Trump threatened to sink any tankers that try to breach it, and CBS reports talks with Qatari mediators are ongoing; no convoy has been confirmed sailing and no ceasefire has been announced.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: AFP, UKMTO, Euronews, Gulf News, CBS News, Fox News, Al Jazeera, CoinDesk

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: CoinGlass data show bitcoin near $63,400 late Mon 23 Nov, after KuCoin's daily report says it touched about $55,100 over the weekend; Crypto.news reports Saylor said Strategy's latest proceeds went $147M to STRC buybacks and only $29.6M to bitcoin. MSCI's deletion takes effect after the close on 30 Nov, and Yahoo Finance cites a JPMorgan estimate of up to $9B in outflows if other index providers follow, which is still open.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, CoinGlass, KuCoin, Crypto.news, Yahoo Finance, Decrypt, FXStreet

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Yahoo Finance reports ANT rose more than 4% premarket on Mon 23 Nov after Friday's 8.5% drop to $88.91, but its quote shows the stock back near $88.85 by early afternoon after trading between $84.81 and $94.24. StockAnalysis lists a 2x leveraged ANT ETF from Leverage Shares launching Monday; whether ANT holds its $83 IPO price and when it joins the Nasdaq 100 are still open.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
sources: Yahoo Finance, CNBC, Seeking Alpha, StockAnalysis, Investing.com, WSJ, Robinhood

title: Binance $6.3B hack, stolen ETH on the move
since_label: Thu 29 Oct 00:00 UTC, before the hack was reported
status: Elliptic's 20 Nov update says the hackers emptied five of the nine largest ETH addresses from 17 to 20 Nov, moving about 488,000 ETH ($860M) and swapping part into bitcoin via THORChain; Crypto Briefing reports at least 2,310 BTC has gone through coinjoins, while the 18,270 BTC taken directly have not moved and about $2.35B still sits in linked addresses. Reuters reports an Abu Dhabi court has ordered 18 firms, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, to keep the tokens frozen, and a hearing on 1 Dec will decide whether the freeze continues.
why: Stolen ETH that no issuer can freeze is being moved and swapped, a supply overhang for ETH and alts while crypto sentiment sits at extreme fear.
next_label: Abu Dhabi court hearing on the freeze order
sources: Elliptic, Reuters, Bitcoin.com News, Cointribune, Crypto Briefing, Coincub, Decrypt, Binance
